description: React hook-based store implementation for managing notification data, including load, mark as read, and real-time update handlers.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads notifications from the notifications service, updates store with data and unread count, and handles errors.

methods.name: markRead
methods.description: Marks a specific notification as read on the server and updates local store and unread count.

methods.name: onRealtimeInsert
methods.description: Inserts new notifications in real-time, updating the store and unread count.

methods.name: onRealtimeUpdate
methods.description: Updates a specific notification in real-time, modifying the store and unread count accordingly.

methods.name: onRealtimeDelete
methods.description: Removes a notification in real-time from the store and updates the unread count.
